newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare to acquire therapy providers.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare to acquire therapy providers.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Thursday it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Rehab Unlimited Inc and certain assets of Cimarron Health Care Inc, both based in Jefferson City, Missouri.
Both are providers of contract therapy services to long-term care facilities and home health agencies. Combined annualized revenues are $3.8 million, RehabCare Group said.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. The acquisition is expected to be completed in the next few days, RehabCare said.
RehabCare shares were down 1-1/4 at 33-1/4 Thursday.
